1.note: Intake the configured host's real process start and eligible tree agents once through the shared OS claim; expose progress through the existing role-launch read route. Unknown process identity does not consume a start. Unreadable daemon-home or task-root intake retries while the give-up window is open; when that failure reaches the configured window, it consumes that exact start and records a `given-up` outcome with its reason. Claim-publication, candidate-read and initial-progress failures use separate retry/release paths and are not subject to this branch's give-up check. The transport performs only a timeline resume, not a message, refresh, interruption or unarchive.
